metadata.title: archive-index: lexical, dense and hybrid search in a multilingual research archive

creators.name: Pylypenko, Oleksandr
creators.affiliation: State University of Trade and Economics, Kyiv, Ukraine

metadata.description:
A system-and-resource study of lexical, dense and hybrid retrieval in a constructed multilingual research archive. UA-PAR contains 7,070 public-source files, 200 model-written queries and 5,572 pooled query–document assessments. The study compares ten retrieval configurations, examines sensitivity to the relevance judge, and reports separate target-format, multimodal, GGUF, resource-cost, synthetic vector-scaling and private-archive operational checks.

Text relevance is assessed by language models. No human relevance audit is included. Results are conditional on the constructed queries, model labels and stated measurement boundaries; no general superiority of the adaptive fusion rule is established.

Proposed deposit: an English manuscript and its Ukrainian edition. Author review, publication date and final public software/data identifiers are pending. This metadata file has not been submitted.
